inspection_method: Model visual inspection of the original-resolution Poppler before/after renders.
verified: The frozen-source commit hash is absent from the corrected title page.
The Turkish title, 722-module subtitle, project attribution, source label, date, CC BY 4.0 notice, and both marks remain visible.
No clipping, overlap, missing glyph, replacement glyph, or unintended raw TeX is visible on the affected page.
The whitespace left by the removed technical line is clean and does not collide with adjacent title-page elements.
claim_boundary: Visual inspection is limited to the sole affected physical page. All other pages are bound separately by text, structure, link, bookmark, and deterministic-build checks.
